lesson-intro.text: Cut an orange across the middle and you find a wheel inside, with eight juicy pieces. Watch the wheel fill in, then cut an orange of your own.

peel-left.text: The orange starts as a big circle. From the top, round down the left side.

peel-right.text: From the top again, round down the right side to close it.

inside-left.text: Just inside it goes a second circle. Draw its left half first.

inside-right.text: Then its right half. The thin ring between them is the peel.

middle.text: Right in the center, draw a little circle the size of a button.

spokes-plus.text: Four spokes go out from the button: up, down, left and right. Stop before the ring.

spokes-x.text: Put one more spoke in each gap, slanting out. Now the wheel has eight.

tops-right.text: Each piece needs a round top. Go down the right side, bumping from spoke to spoke.

tops-left.text: Keep going up the left side until all eight pieces are closed.

segments.text: Color all eight pieces golden yellow.

rest.text: The space around the pieces is cream, and so is the button.

lesson-outro.text: Eight juicy pieces in one round wheel. Give it a squeeze and you'd have orange juice.
